description: This file contains utility functions and type annotations related to Pydantic models, FastAPI, and data serialization, including compatibility handling for different Pydantic versions.

methods.name: lenient_issubclass
methods.description: Checks if a class is a subclass of another, with compatibility considerations for different Pydantic versions.

methods.name: _annotation_is_sequence
methods.description: Determines if a type annotation represents a sequence type.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation indicates a sequence type, considering Union types.

methods.name: value_is_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a value is a sequence type excluding strings and bytes.

methods.name: _annotation_is_complex
methods.description: Determines if a type annotation is complex, such as a Pydantic model, mapping, or upload file.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_complex
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation is complex, considering nested annotations and special attributes.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_scalar
methods.description: Determines if a field annotation is scalar, handling Ellipsis for variadic tuples.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_scalar_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation is a scalar sequence.

methods.name: is_bytes_or_nonable_bytes_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is bytes or a nullable bytes type.

methods.name: is_uploadfile_or_nonable_uploadfile_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is UploadFile or a nullable UploadFile.

methods.name: is_bytes_sequence_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: is_uploadfile_sequence_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a sequence of UploadFile.

methods.name: is_pydantic_v1_model_instance
methods.description: Checks if an object is an instance of a Pydantic v1 model.

methods.name: is_pydantic_v1_model_class
methods.description: Checks if a class is a subclass of Pydantic v1 BaseModel.

methods.name: annotation_is_pydantic_v1
methods.description: Determines if an annotation is a Pydantic v1 model or contains such models.
